independence_mechanism: For each seed, permute the same 100000 base vectors before serial single-threaded Faiss HNSW insertion. Remap exact-neighbor IDs through the inverse permutation; query vectors and truth distances are unchanged.

tcp_policy.target_build_protocol: Each build is target in turn; all other registered builds form the cached source pool.
tcp_policy.action: For each query, use the conformal order statistic of source-build minimum-safe ef actions at alpha=0.05; BOT or insufficient finite source actions triggers ef=200 fallback.
tcp_policy.evaluation_blindness: Target evaluation labels cannot alter the pool, order statistic, or fallback.

darth_policy: Train on the designated source build role and freeze before applying to each independent target rebuild; target-retrained DARTH is reported separately as a recovery comparator.
